essence: The mantra should be written in the pericarp of the eight-petaled lotus.
The syllables 'baṭukāya' should be written outside on the sixteen-petaled lotus.
Each letter should be written individually outside on the sixteen-petaled lotus.
The letters from ka to sa should be written in the outer ground enclosure.
The word śrī functions as a destroyer of misfortune, disease, and evil planetary influences.
